config.title: Flat Swap in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: How a Wohnungstausch works in Berlin, and what it does to your rent with a state-owned or a private landlord.

items.q: Can I swap my flat in Berlin?
items.a: Only if both landlords agree. German tenancy law gives tenants **no right to swap**. The exception is the seven state-owned housing companies: their tenants can swap with each other through the official portal on inberlinwohnen.de.

items.q: Does the rent change when I swap a flat in Berlin?
items.a: On the state-owned swap portal, **no: both net cold rents stay unchanged**, so you take over the other tenant's rent. In a private swap the incoming tenant signs a new lease, and the landlord may set a new rent within the Mietpreisbremse.

items.q: Who can use the Berlin Wohnungstausch portal?
items.a: Main tenants of degewo, GESOBAU, Gewobag, HOWOGE, STADT UND LAND, WBM and berlinovo whose lease is **not already terminated** and who have an **email address on file** with their company. You can swap across all seven companies.

items.q: How many flat swaps actually happen in Berlin?
items.a: Few. In 2024 the state-owned swap route produced **327 new leases**, 309 of them started on the portal, against roughly 370,000 state-owned flats. Internal moves within one company produced 716 new leases that year.

items.q: What is the Wohnungswechsel downsizing offer?
items.a: Since **1 September 2025** a main tenant of a state-owned company who wants a flat **at least one room and 10 m² smaller** gets up to three offers from their own company within twelve months. The new flat is let at the **local comparative rent without a new-letting surcharge**, and the move is timed so you do not pay two rents.

items.q: How high can the rent be after a private flat swap?
items.a: The Mietpreisbremse, extended in Berlin until **31 December 2029**, caps a new lease at **10 percent above the local comparative rent**. A landlord may keep a higher previous rent, and flats first let after 1 October 2014 or after a comprehensive modernisation are outside the cap.

items.q: Should I pay someone to swap flats with me?
items.a: No. A flat is not the outgoing tenant's to sell. A swap ad that asks for money up front is the moment to walk away.
